calculation.expression: clip((-return_20d / (annualized_volatility_20d + 0.04)) * (0.65 + 0.70 * I[VIX_return_10d > 0 and DXY_return_10d > 0]), -5, 5), lagged 1 session
calculation.description: Cross-asset contrarian price shock signal, strengthened when both observation-only VIX and DXY have risen over the prior 10 sessions. All inputs are lagged one completed session to avoid look-ahead. VIX and DXY are macro observations only and are not tradable constituents.

validation.regime_notes: 60-session IC remained positive across 2027 (0.200899), 2028-2029 (0.097408), 2030 (0.225176), 2031-2032 (0.106709), and 2033 YTD (0.055771). Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative interpretation despite long history.
